$comment: Canonical upstream event sequences. These mirror what the real Command Code /alpha/generate emits, as observed in production. Both the Node implementation and the Rust rewrite must translate these identically.

clean-text.description: A minimal successful turn: start, one text delta, finish with usage.

multi-delta.description: Several text deltas that must be emitted as separate SSE chunks in order.

reasoning-then-text.description: Reasoning deltas precede the answer; Anthropic must open a thinking block first.

tool-call-delta-then-final.description: Streamed tool arguments followed by the canonical final object. The deltas concatenate exactly to the final JSON, so the encoder must not duplicate the payload.

tool-call-final-only.description: A canonical tool call with no preceding deltas — the arguments must be emitted whole.

parallel-tool-calls.description: Two tool calls in one turn, each with its own index.

start-only-truncated.description: Upstream closes the socket after `start` with no finish. The proxy must synthesise the terminal records instead of leaving the stream dangling.

text-without-finish.description: Deltas arrive, then the connection closes with no finish event — synthesised termination required.

error-event.description: An in-band error event. The downstream client must receive exactly one error envelope (retryable class) and no synthesised success finish.

error-after-content.description: Content already streamed when the upstream fails. Content must be preserved and the error surfaced after it.

late-event-after-finish.description: A misbehaving upstream keeps sending after finish. The encoder must swallow the stragglers and not emit a second terminal record.

length-finish-reason.description: finishReason=length must map to max_tokens on the Anthropic side.

garbage-lines.description: NDJSON lines that are not JSON at all. The parser must skip them and still terminate cleanly.

empty-body.description: A 200 with zero bytes — the proxy must synthesise an empty but valid turn.

reset-mid-stream.description: The upstream dies after the first delta. The client must get a terminal error, not a hang.

hang-after-start.description: Upstream opens the stream then goes silent forever. Used to pin the idle-timeout behaviour.

httpFailures.$comment: Header-phase failures. Each must produce the documented downstream status and envelope shape.
